status: Approved compact design; implementation and release validation in progress for 0.3.4.

Only optional performance information and playback controls remain; no status row or linear progress bar.

58dp primary playback action retains its preparation ring and cancellation behavior.
Audio preparation and metric updates retain identical card and control geometry.
Reader controls > Quick > Show performance info toggles the saved showPerformance preference.
Full preparation progress, issues and cancellation remain in Reader menu > Reading details.
Controls-sheet footer retains detailed feedback and errors.
validationScope: Compose layout/action tests, source unit tests, lint, signed artifact verification, and real Android emulator preparation/playback/toggle-persistence checks. No physical-phone test.
